text: PR #5407 update: second adversarial /code-review pass against 8490854e4 found 3 more real issues, fixed in af352b005: path_of_handle() (added in round 1) didn't strip the \\?\ extended-length prefix GetFinalPathNameByHandleW returns, which would've made every legitimate Windows containment check fail outside_root on its first component -- fail-closed but a total functional break on Windows, fixed by mirroring stripping logic already used elsewhere in this codebase for the same API call. read_physically_contained_file_snapshot()'s POSIX reopen was still missing the O_NONBLOCK round 1 added to the check walk (same FIFO-hang class) -- fixed and now covered by a new mkfifo + time-bounded std::async regression test. A misleading comment overclaiming the canonical_path string's trust binding was corrected. One further finding (read_physically_contained_file_snapshot reopening by path string rather than the verified descriptor/handle) was confirmed via the pre-PR baseline to predate this PR entirely and is bounded by device+inode identity comparison, not trivially exploitable -- deferred as issue #5409, sub-issue of #34. Re-ran the full local Linux battery clean (7/7) again. Judged a third adversarial pass not worth its cost given round 2's changes were narrow and mirror already-tested patterns; a fresh Windows Native Validation dispatch against af352b005 (run 33330266844) is the real remaining gate before merge -- every earlier Windows run (33328528574, 33329378451) is against a superseded commit and should not be trusted.
